name: line-items-table
title: Line items table
description: Priced lines as a table: description, quantity, unit price and amount, with subtotal, discount, shipping, VAT and total in a real tfoot, counted in whole cents.
docs: lines holds { id, description, detail?, quantity, unit?, unitAmount }, with unitAmount in minor units (8900 is 89.00) and a quantity that may be a fraction (hours, metres). Every amount is worked out in whole minor units and rounded once per row, so the rows always add up to the total: a line is quantity times unitAmount, discount is { label?, percent?, amount? } (the percentage of the subtotal first, then the fixed amount, never more than the subtotal), shipping is an amount or { label, amount } (0 shows 'Free') and taxRate is a percentage (21 for 21%), worked out on the subtotal less the discount plus shipping. The prices exclude VAT unless you set taxIncluded, as on a shop receipt: the row then reads 'Includes VAT 21%' and the total does not change. A row that does not apply is left out, and with nothing to add or take off there is only the total. The footer is a real tfoot with row headers, the total is set apart by a heavier rule and counts to a new value (AnimatedPrice) when the lines, the discount or the shipping change. title names the table; without it labels.caption does. Below the container width of 36rem each line becomes a card with its own subtotal and the footer a description list. It needs no client code of its own, so a Server Component can render it. totalsOf is exported, so your server works out the same figures. Always pass locale; labels holds every word.
